---
title: "Simplest Chaotic System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& y\\
\dot{y} &=& z\\
\dot{z} &=& az+y^2-x
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-2.02$ and initial condition $(-1,0,0)$.
